metadata.title: Bhagavad Gita - Complete Shlokas
metadata.description: Complete collection of Bhagavad Gita verses with Sanskrit, transliteration, translation, and word meanings

3.chapter_summary: This chapter lays the foundation for one of the Gita's central teachings — the path of selfless action. Krishna explains that outward renunciation is not necessary; what truly matters is the inner renunciation of attachment.

3-1.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
ज्यायसी चेत्कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिर्जनार्दन ।
तत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव
3-1.transliteration_iast:
arjuna uvāca
jyāyasī cetkarmaṇaste matā buddhirjanārdana
tatkiṃ karmaṇi ghore māṃ niyojayasi keśava
3-1.transliteration_simple:
arjuna uvaacha
jyaayasii chet karmanas te mataa buddhir janaardana
tat kim karmani ghore maam niyojayasi keshava
3-1.english_translation: Arjuna said: If it be thought by you that knowledge is superior to action, O Janardana, why then, do you, O Kashava, engage me in this terrible action?

3-2.sanskrit:
व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे ।
तदेकं वद निश्चित्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम्
3-2.transliteration_iast:
vyāmiśreṇeva vākyena buddhiṃ mohayasīva me
tadekaṃ vada niścitya yena śreyo'hamāpnuyām
3-2.transliteration_simple:
vyaamishrena iva vaakyena buddhim mohayasi iva me
tad ekam vada nishchitya yena shreyah aham aapnuyaam
3-2.english_translation: With this apparently perplexing speech you confuse, as it were, my understanding; therefore, tell me that one way by which I for certain may attain the Highest.

4.chapter_summary: This chapter unites the paths of knowledge and action. Krishna reveals how divine wisdom transforms ordinary work into a means of liberation.

4-1.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम् ।
विवस्वान्मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत्
4-1.transliteration_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
imaṃ vivasvate yogaṃ proktavānahamavyayam
vivasvānmanave prāha manurikṣvākave'bravīt
4-1.transliteration_simple:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
imam vivasvate yogam proktavaan aham avyayam
vivasvaan manave praaha manuh ikshvaakave 'braviit
4-1.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: I taught this Imperishable YOGA to Vivasvan; Vivasvan taught it to Manu; Manu taught it to Ikshvaku.
